witnesses.name: proof_of_DeInitDataqueue_which_implies_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Unfold store_dataqueue into nonzero/aligned structure fields, padding and dataqueue_buffer. Choose each existential field value from q. Split on dq_base q=0. Null branch buffer is emp and slots=nil; choose left alternative and cancel all fields/padding. Nonnull branch has positive max_len and complete store_array dataqueue_slot; prove its conversion into CharArray.undef_full base (max_len*8) by induction on slots/array representation. For None slots forget no values; for Some slots forget data/length values using typed-store-to-undef facts. Authorized dataqueue_layout_abi converts offsets and 8-byte strides; concatenate each slot two four-byte blocks, retaining the structure/padding frame. Array length originates in store_array and scalar range in field stores, not a new assumption. dataqueue_buffer_free_obligation is only a Prop and must not be used as a theorem.

Unfold abs_deinit_dataqueue; use safeExec of assertS to obtain dataqueue_cleanup_entry for the initial LastSeen set. Crtos_RTrans before observed establishes membership in that observation set. Instantiate entry at observed to get os_inv |-- cleanup_guard, then project both quiescence facts while preserving os_inv by pure extraction/frame. Cancel InsideCritical/private store_dataqueue unchanged. Do not select the pure emp fallback: its generated split drops the os_inv needed by cleanup_entry. Whitelist001 permits this checked observation model, not assuming the resulting facts without this argument.
